description:
Problem: the protocol marker is zlib plus base64 of defect titles and the DO NOT SHIP summary, built at finalize before redact-check, which matches plain text only (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/report.py:113-124, protocol.py:215-219). Finalize also writes the unredacted body to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY before the redact step runs (cli.py:831-833). A secret the loop step does not hold but the reviewer quotes would survive in the marker and the step summary. (Re-graded Consider by the Advisor; the owner chose to close every gap.)

Outcome: redaction is applied before the marker is built (or the marker is rebuilt from redacted findings); redact-check decodes the marker and fails closed on a hit; the step summary is written only after redact-check succeeds.

Decision gates:
1. Every marker consumer (gate, carry, history parsing) accepts the rebuilt marker; existing marker round-trip tests prove it.

Item guardrails: no change to the decision or posting order other than moving the summary after redaction.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build whose SHA-256 that item records, verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge, a stand-in, an adjudication, or a ruleset or settings change. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
